commentary: With the deterministic gate flagged as WEAK and market breadth deteriorating to a reading of 41, William O'Neil's market-direction rule dictates severe capital preservation: an 'Uptrend Under Pressure' transitioning toward correction. Stan Weinstein's stage analysis reminds us that when frontline benchmarks break below short-term moving averages amidst persistent institutional distribution (FPI net outflows), Stage 2 breakout failure rates escalate exponentially. In this hostile tape, Jesse Livermore’s rule is absolute: cash is a valid, high-yielding position. Mark Minervini's progressive exposure requires keeping risk tight, cutting losses without hesitation, and restricting new exposure exclusively to verified leaders showing explosive earnings acceleration and institutional volume pivots, while capping non-qualifying setups firmly on the watch list.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA / O'Neil CANSLIM / Weinstein Stage Analysis

63MOONS.technical: Price holds above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with 3.63x volume expansion and RSI 62. Forming a double bottom neckline test near 958.91, but overhead supply remains heavy from historical structural consolidations.
63MOONS.fundamental: Top-line surged to ₹137 Cr (+350% YoY), but operations produced a ₹71.7 Cr loss, resulting in a net loss of ₹47.56 Cr in Q1 FY27. Erratic profitability and sub-5% ROE violate CANSLIM standards.
63MOONS.risk: A decisive breakdown below 874.42 invalidates the double-bottom pivot, necessitating an immediate stop-out to protect trading capital.

ABDL.technical: Carving out a post-IPO double bottom above rising 50 and 200-day SMAs. RSI 66 indicates solid relative strength, but approaching the 754.55 neckline trigger on average volume (1.29x) lacks decisive institutional accumulation.
ABDL.fundamental: Q1 FY27 sales grew ~7% YoY to ₹979 Cr while EPS growth slowed sharply to 12% (₹2.44), down from high previous-quarter comps. Moderate operating margins (~13.8% OPM) fail CANSLIM's 25% earnings hurdle.
ABDL.risk: Failure to hold 689.11 invalidates the right side of the base, demanding swift liquidation to prevent extended drawdown.

ADVANCE.technical: Classic Stage 2 continuation breakout clearing the 20-session high on a massive 41.44x volume explosion. Price is comfortably above EMA21 and SMAs 50/200; MACD confirms strong upward momentum across multiple timeframes.
ADVANCE.fundamental: Superb CANSLIM fundamental profile: Q1 FY27 revenue doubled to ₹330.4 Cr (+96% YoY) while PAT surged 152% to ₹22.55 Cr. High capital returns (ROE 17.2%, ROCE 19.6%) and 70% promoter ownership validate institutional sponsorship.
ADVANCE.risk: Close below 125.05 invalidates the breakout box; enforce immediate stop discipline to insulate against adverse market breadth.

AEROENTER.technical: Consolidating above key EMAs/SMAs with RSI 61 in a double bottom formation beneath 159.76. Recent inside-day compression reflects volatility dampening, though trading volume lacks dominant institutional accumulation characteristics.
AEROENTER.fundamental: Standalone core sales contracted 5% YoY to ₹28.2 Cr in Q1 FY27 with EBITDA margins collapsing to 5.7%. Net profit is heavily distorted by ₹144+ Cr non-operating other income, failing CANSLIM earnings purity.
AEROENTER.risk: Violation of 146.32 breaches the swing trough; execute strict stop discipline to avoid severe liquidity traps in small-cap turnarounds.

ALLDIGI.technical: Cleared a 20-day high at 894.79 supported by a 10.53x volume expansion and MACD above zero line. Structure demonstrates constructive Stage 2 characteristics, though overhead supply near the 1,000 peak remains unabsorbed.
ALLDIGI.fundamental: Superior return metrics (ROE 32.8%, ROCE 27.9%) and zero net debt provide high fundamental quality. However, top-line growth slowed to 4.4% in Q1 FY27 and EPS growth decelerated to 22%, missing strict CANSLIM criteria.
ALLDIGI.risk: A break below 848 compromises breakout integrity; cut the position immediately to adhere to Minervini risk parameters.

ANGELONE.technical: Coiling within 1.5% of the 330.13 pivot in an orderly Stage 1 base above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. RSI 58 shows steady absorption without extension, awaiting breakout volume expansion.
ANGELONE.fundamental: Operating momentum re-accelerated sharply in Q1 FY27, with revenue climbing 25.4% YoY to ₹1,434 Cr and net profit doubling (+102%) to ₹231.4 Cr. Healthy 35% operating margins and structural retail tailwinds support expansion.
ANGELONE.risk: Close below 310.37 violates the base support floor; exit immediately per Livermore and Minervini risk-management tenets.
